20.name: Devin withholds his decision
20.description: Devin stays still, avoids saying what he has decided, and signals that he will not tell Asha his plan this morning.
evidence: Devin did not move from the linoleum
He did not say what he would do with that gap.
He did not say he would close it for her.
he was not, this morning, going to tell her what he had decided.

"I corrected it before she finished her direct, Asha. The intake stamp will show it. The transcript will show it."

evidence: Asha came up the firm's back corridor with the briefcase against her hip and stopped at Whitfield's door without knocking yet.

she let her shoulders settle a quarter inch lower

20.name: Asha leaves decision to Whitfield

whatever Whitfield did with the gap between the two stamps would be his to do first

evidence: The radiator ticked once more behind his chair and did not tick again

she had decided in the hallway that she would not be the one to fill the gap she had come here to name

The radiator did not tick again, and the four-eighteen stamp sat where she had placed it, and Whitfield's hand, when it finally moved, moved toward the page rather than away from it

20.name: Whitfield remains silent

20.description: Asha moves to the cabinet by Whitfield's window and takes the trial record and intake log from the Hatcher working file without asking.

she drew out the trial record and the intake log without asking

20.name: Asha withholds explanation

evidence: She waited, because the version of her judgment he carried into the one o'clock would be built partly out of whether she could stand inside this without explaining it.

20.name: Asha remains motionless

Her gaze stayed fixed on the small lift of Whitfield's finger above the intake sheet, on the quarter-inch of air between his hand and the four-eighteen stamp, and she let that distance be the whole of what was happening in the room.

20.name: Asha resolves not to speak
20.description: After stepping back, Asha decides she will not speak again until Whitfield does and holds herself steady in silence.
evidence: She had decided in the half pace back that she would not speak again until he did, and she held to it now with her hands at her sides and her breath evened against the silence.

evidence: Whitfield's eyes returned to the trial record, then to the intake log, then to the page he had been touching when she walked in, and the order he read them in was the order the clerk had pressed them, not the order she had given him at nine.

20.name: Silence stretches in the room

evidence: The radiator stayed quiet, and the finger stayed lifted, and Asha waited for him to be the one who put a sentence into the gap.
